library(AOData); library(tidyverse)

### Omega-3 supplementation

```{r}
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 20



idkeys <- AOData::idkeys %>%
  select(participant, treat, sex, completed) %>%
  filter(completed != "t1") %>%
  select(-completed) 

AOData::omega3  %>%
  inner_join(idkeys) %>%
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2")) %>%
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value") %>%
  
  
  ggplot(aes(time, value, color = treat, group = paste(participant, fa))) + 
  geom_line() + facet_wrap(fa ~ treat, ncol = 2, scales = "free") + 
  
  labs(title = "Individual changes in EPA (C205n3) and DHA (226n3) by treatment group", 
       y = "ug ml-1", 
       x = "Time")
  


```



```{r}

library(gt)


## ANCOVA 


dat <- AOData::omega3  %>%
  inner_join(idkeys) %>%
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2")) %>%
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = value) 
  

fas <- distinct(dat, fa) %>%
  pull(fa)

results <- data.frame(fa = rep(NA, length(fas)),
                        estimate = rep(NA, length(fas)), 
           se= rep(NA, length(fas)), 
           t= rep(NA, length(fas)), 
           p= rep(NA, length(fas)), 
           lwr= rep(NA, length(fas)), 
           upr= rep(NA, length(fas)))


for(i in 1:length(fas)) {
  
  mod <- lm(T2 ~ T1 + treat, data = dat[dat$fa == fas[i],])
  
  results[i, 2] <- coef(summary(mod))[3,1]
  results[i, 3] <- coef(summary(mod))[3,2]
  results[i, 4] <- coef(summary(mod))[3,3]
  results[i, 5] <- coef(summary(mod))[3,4]
  results[i, 6] <- confint(mod)[3,1]
  results[i, 7] <- confint(mod)[3,2]

  results[i, 1] <- fas[i]
  
}


AOData::omega3  %>%
  inner_join(idkeys) %>%
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2")) %>%
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value") %>%
  
  group_by(time, treat, fa) %>%
  
  summarise(m = mean(value), 
            s = sd(value), 
            min = min(value), 
            max = max(value)) %>%
  arrange(fa, treat) %>%
  
  mutate(descriptives = paste0(round(m, 1), " (", round(s, 1), ")")) %>%
  
  select(time:fa, descriptives) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = descriptives, names_from = time) %>%
  
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(T1, T2), names_from = treat) %>%
  
  inner_join(results) %>%
  
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = estimate:upr, 
             decimals = 3) 
  
           
  




```


### Glucose metabolism


```{r}
#| label: tbl-glucose
#| tbl-cap: "ANCOVA results Omega-3 vs. CTRL (T2 ~ T1 + treat)"



dat <- AOData::glucose %>%
  filter(!(is.na(cpeptide)), 
         time %in% c("T1", "T2")) %>%
  inner_join(idkeys) %>%
  
  select(participant, treat, time, min, glucose:HOMA2IR) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = glucose:HOMA2IR) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = value, 
              names_from = time) %>%
  mutate(min = if_else(min == 0, "baseline", "min60")) 



analyte <- distinct(dat, name) %>% pull(name)
results_list <- list()

for(i in 1:length(analyte)) {
  
  
  time_res <- list()
  min <- c("baseline", "min60")
  results <- data.frame(analyste = rep(NA, 2),
                        min = rep(NA, 2),
                        estimate = rep(NA, 2), 
           se= rep(NA, 2),
           t= rep(NA, 2),
           p= rep(NA, 2), 
           lwr= rep(NA, 2),
           upr=rep(NA, 2))
  
  for(j in 1:2) {
    
    mod <- lm(T2 ~ T1 + treat, data = dat[dat$name == analyte[i] & dat$min == min[j],])
    
  results[j, 1] <- analyte[i]
  results[j, 2] <- min[j]
  results[j, 3] <- coef(summary(mod))[3,1]
  results[j, 4] <- coef(summary(mod))[3,2]
  results[j, 5] <- coef(summary(mod))[3,3]
  results[j, 6] <- coef(summary(mod))[3,4]
  results[j, 7] <- confint(mod)[3,1]
  results[j, 8] <- confint(mod)[3,2]

    
  }
  
  
 results_list[[i]] <- results
  
  
}


bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(decimals = 3)
  
  
  
  
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-align: "center"


dat %>%
  
  pivot_longer(cols = T1:T2, 
               names_to = "time", 
               values_to = "value") %>%

  mutate(measurement = min) %>%
  group_by(time, measurement, name, treat) %>%
  
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  
  summarise(m = mean(value), 
            s = sd(value), 
            min = min(value), 
            max = max(value), 
            n = n()) %>%
  arrange(name, treat) %>%
  
  mutate(descriptives = paste0(round(m, 1), " (", round(s, 1), "), n=", n)) %>%
  
  
  ggplot(aes(treat, m, fill = time, shape = time)) +
  
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = m - s, ymax = m + s),
                width = 0,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
  
  facet_wrap(name ~ measurement, scales = "free", 
             ncol = 2)
  


```



```{r}
#| label: tbl-maximal-glucose
#| tbl-cap: "Maximal glucose during glucose tolerance test"

### Peak glucose and glucose curves



dat <- AOData::glucose %>%
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2"), 
         !is.na(glucose)) %>%
  select(participant:glucose) %>%
  
  summarise(.by = c(participant, time), 
            max.glucose = max(glucose) )  %>%
  inner_join(idkeys) 
  
  
dat %>%
  group_by(time, treat) %>%
  mutate(above10 = if_else(max.glucose >= 10, 1, 0), 
         above11 = if_else(max.glucose >= 11, 1, 0)) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(max.glucose), 
            SD = sd(max.glucose),
            Min = min(max.glucose), 
            Max = max(max.glucose),
            n_above10 = sum(above10), 
            n_above11 = sum(above11),
            n = n()) %>%
  
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Mean, SD, Min, Max), 
             decimals = 2)





```


```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Peak glucose from glucose tolerance test"


dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(time, max.glucose, fill = treat)) + geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.75 ))

```




```{r}
#| label: tbl-resting-glucose
#| tbl-cap: "Resting and 2-h glucose from glucose tolerance test"

### Peak glucose and glucose curves



dat <- AOData::glucose %>%
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2"), 
         !is.na(glucose)) %>%
  select(participant:glucose) %>%
  filter(min %in% c(0, 120)) %>%
  summarise(.by = c(participant, time, min), 
            glucose = glucose)  %>%
  inner_join(idkeys) 
  
  
dat %>%
  group_by(time, treat, min) %>%
  mutate(above7 = if_else(glucose >= 7, 1, 0), 
         above11 = if_else(glucose >= 11, 1, 0)) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(glucose), 
            SD = sd(glucose),
            Min = min(glucose), 
            Max = max(glucose),
            n_above7 = sum(above7), 
            n_above11 = sum(above11),
            n = n()) %>%
  
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Mean, SD, Min, Max), 
             decimals = 2)




```


```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Resting glucose from glucose tolerance test"


dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(time, glucose, fill = treat)) + geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.75 )) + 
  facet_wrap(~ min)

```









### ECSS abstract: Relative fat mass is not associated with muscle adaptations to resistance training





```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptive statistics Vastus lateralis thickness (VL) at time 2 and 4 (T) and relative fat mass at T2"

library(AOData); library(tidyverse); library(lme4); library(gt)


part <- AOData::idkeys %>%
  filter(completed == "t4") 


dat_fm <- AOData::bodycomp %>%
  
  inner_join(mutate(part, participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  
  mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.legs / (fat.legs + lean.legs + BMC.legs))) %>%
  select(participant, time, sex, bmi, rel.fm) %>%
  inner_join(mutate(AOData::thickness, participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  
  select(-VIthick) %>%

  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = c(VLthick, rel.fm), 
              values_fn = mean) 
  
  

dat_fm %>%
  group_by(participant, sex) %>%
  summarise(rel.fmT2 = mean(rel.fm_T2, na.rm = TRUE), 
            VLT2 = mean(VLthick_T2, na.rm = TRUE), 
             VLT4 = mean(VLthick_T4, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(names_to = "var", values_to = "val", cols = rel.fmT2:VLT4) %>%
  group_by(sex, var) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), 
            s = sd(val, na.rm = TRUE), 
            n = n()) %>%
  
  
  
  gt() %>%
  fmt_auto()
```


```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Model results T4 vastus lateralis thickness explained by baseline thickness (VLthick_T2), sex and relative fat mass (%) at time 2 (rel.fm_T2). For every % change in relative fat mass, vastus lateralis changes ~ 0.03 mm."


m1 <- lmerTest::lmer(VLthick_T4 ~ VLthick_T2 + rel.fm_T2 + sex + (1|participant), 
           data = dat_fm) 


coef(summary(m1)) %>%
   data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  
  gt() %>%
  fmt_auto()
```


```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Model results T4 lean mass explained by baseline lean mass (lean_T2), sex and relative fat mass (%) at time 2 (rel.fm_T2). For every % change in relative fat mass, lean mass changes ~ 3 g."


##### Lean body mass #################

dat_lean <- AOData::bodycomp %>%
  
  inner_join(mutate(part, participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  
  mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole + BMC.whole))) %>%
  
  select(participant, time, sex, bmi, lean = lean.legs, rel.fm)  %>%

  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = c(lean, rel.fm), 
              values_fn = mean) 
  


m2 <- lm(lean_T4 ~ lean_T2 + rel.fm_T2 + sex, 
           data = dat_lean)  




coef(summary(m2)) %>%
   data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  
  gt() %>%
  fmt_auto()

```


```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Model results T4 legpress 1RM explained by baseline leg press (T2), sex and relative fat mass (%) at time 2 (rel.fm). For every % change in relative fat mass, lean mass changes ~ 0.2 kg."


str_dat<- AOData::strength %>%
  
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  filter(exercise == "legpress") %>%
  
  select(participant:mag) %>%
  inner_join(mutate(part, participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  
  inner_join(dat_lean %>% select(participant, rel.fm = rel.fm_T2) ) %>%
  
  pivot_wider(values_from = mag, names_from = time, values_fn = mean) %>%
  filter(T4 > 0) 



m3 <- lmerTest::lmer(T4 ~ T2 + rel.fm + sex + (1|participant), 
           data = str_dat)  


coef(summary(m3)) %>%
   data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  
  gt() %>%
  fmt_auto()

```
